name: Jacques Laurent
source:
Jacques Laurent is a senior film student at Olympus University, an unusual path to take at a sports-based college. Altough not particularly athletic, Jacques is ambitious, founding the soon-to-be 'Jock Studio' and seeking to use it to gain what he truly wants before his college life is over!

[From [url=https://www.blitsgames.com/jock-studio/]BLits[/url]]
